title: pm-dispatch: a self-labelled card missing filing-gate answers is completed by triage at first touch, not closed; lanes always mark pm:retriage; triage spot-checks queued self-labelled cards too
body:
**Filing gate ③**, a task the maintainer directed. In the triage seat's chat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, seat post #6015) on 2026-10-19, the maintainer asked 「这种卡你是不是不会处理，结果车道也不接」 about #24535, then 「或者 skills 应该调整？」. On the seat's three options the maintainer answered 「B」. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` lane, in one text PR under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`. It is governed surface, and both `domain:skills` seat posts (#7623, #19287) are vacant, so the maintainer merges it.

**Dedupe:** semantic search on this repository for "self-labelled card missing filing gate answers triage closes first touch lane retriage" found no open card on this rule. The nearest are #24481 and #24289 (closed: lane corrections of self-labelled cards, a different defect).

## What happened (measured, 2026-10-19)

- #24535, #24536, #24537 and #24523 (the `repo:cloud#2` seat) and objectui#13046, objectui#12978 and #24525 arrived self-labelled with `priority:*` + `domain:*` + `pm:queue`. Each lacked one or more of the three answers `filing-gate.md:26` requires.
- The `domain:cli` seat correctly did not claim #24535 (`execution-duties.md:11`). It left a comment (`6268618232`) instead of `pm:retriage`, so the card was in no triage bucket.
- The triage sweep reads ungraded cards and `pm:retriage`. Its self-labelled spot-check (`triage-duties.md:17`) covers only cards **dispatched** in the window. So a queued self-labelled card that no lane may claim waited unseen.
- Read literally, `filing-gate.md:27` would have had triage close all seven, including a p1 measured at 11.8% of a read's CPU. Each close-and-refile costs about four writes against the issue-volume concern this gate exists for (the maintainer, 2026-09-21), and it loses the card's thread.

## What to change (the ruling, B)

1. **`filing-gate.md:27`** — today: 「缺任一件的卡由分诊首触即关、不定级,关单一行点名缺的是哪一件。」
   New rule: at first touch, triage completes the answers it can derive from the card and a search (the category ①–④, the reader who acts, the dedupe query with its hit count, closed included), posts them in its grading comment, and grades.
   It closes at first touch only a card it cannot complete, that is one that is none of the four categories, or a `finding` with no `reach:`. It closes it `not_planned`, in one line naming what is missing.
2. **`execution-duties.md:11`** — keep 「缺一 ⇒ 挂 `pm:retriage`」 and add: ⛔ a comment without the label does not count. The label is what puts the card in triage's sweep.
3. **`triage-duties.md:17`** — widen the spot-check from cards **dispatched** in the window to cards **created** in the window whose `domain:*` event is in the same minute as creation, `pm:queue` included. Check the lane against the table and the three answers on each, completing them per item 1.
4. ⛔ No new gate. `issue-create.mjs` gains no refusal (「新增门禁默认否」).

## Acceptance

- `grep -n '首触即关、不定级' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` answers nothing.
- The three files agree:
  - triage completes what it can derive;
  - lanes label `pm:retriage`;
  - the spot-check covers queued self-labelled cards.
- The PR body quotes the maintainer's words above.
